% Copied verbatim from the PKMS vault house style (~/Documents/PKMS/reports/styles/header-pkms.tex); do not edit here.
% =====================================================================
% Style B — "PKMS" : a custom, minimal Beamer theme (house palette)
% A flat, left-aligned look: ink text on white, a single accent rule under
% each frame title, a quiet footline, custom title + section pages.
% Deck front-matter sets a neutral base (theme: default); everything is
% overridden below, so it is robust to whatever base theme is loaded.
% =====================================================================

\setbeamertemplate{navigation symbols}{}

% ---- Colors ----
\setbeamercolor{normal text}{fg=pkmsink,bg=white}
\setbeamercolor{structure}{fg=accentblue}
\setbeamercolor{alerted text}{fg=accentred}
\setbeamercolor{frametitle}{fg=pkmsink,bg=white}
\setbeamercolor{title}{fg=pkmsink}
\usebeamercolor[fg]{normal text}

% ---- Fonts ----
\setbeamerfont{title}{size=\huge,series=\bfseries}
\setbeamerfont{subtitle}{size=\large,series=\mdseries}
\setbeamerfont{frametitle}{size=\Large,series=\bfseries}
\setbeamerfont{author}{size=\normalsize}
\setbeamerfont{date}{size=\small}

% ---- Frame title: left aligned, ink, thin accent rule underneath ----
\setbeamertemplate{frametitle}{%
  \vspace{0.7em}%
  {\usebeamerfont{frametitle}\usebeamercolor[fg]{frametitle}\insertframetitle\par}%
  \vspace{0.18em}%
  {\color{accentblue}\rule{\textwidth}{1.2pt}}%
  \vspace{-0.1em}%
}

% ---- Footline: author  ·  short title  ·  n / N ----
\setbeamertemplate{footline}{%
  \leavevmode%
  \hbox to\paperwidth{%
    \hspace{1.4em}%
    {\color{accentgray}\scriptsize\insertshortauthor}%
    \hfill%
    {\color{accentgray}\scriptsize\insertshorttitle}%
    \hfill%
    {\color{accentgray}\scriptsize\insertframenumber\,/\,\inserttotalframenumber}%
    \hspace{1.4em}%
  }%
  \vspace{0.7em}%
}

% ---- Title page ----
\setbeamertemplate{title page}{%
  \vbox{}\vfill
  \begingroup
    \raggedright
    {\color{accentblue}\rule{0.18\textwidth}{3pt}\par}
    \vspace{0.8em}
    {\usebeamerfont{title}\usebeamercolor[fg]{title}\inserttitle\par}
    \ifx\insertsubtitle\empty\else
      \vspace{0.45em}
      {\usebeamerfont{subtitle}\color{accentgray}\insertsubtitle\par}
    \fi
    \vspace{1.5em}
    {\usebeamerfont{author}\insertauthor\par}
    \vspace{0.2em}
    {\color{accentgray}\small\insertinstitute\par}
    \vspace{0.8em}
    {\usebeamerfont{date}\color{accentgray}\insertdate\par}
  \endgroup
  \vfill
}

% ---- Section divider ----
\AtBeginSection[]{%
  \begin{frame}[plain,noframenumbering]
    \vfill
    \begingroup
      \raggedright
      {\color{accentblue}\rule{0.12\textwidth}{3pt}\par}
      \vspace{0.7em}
      {\usebeamerfont{frametitle}\color{pkmsink}\bfseries\insertsectionhead\par}
    \endgroup
    \vfill
  \end{frame}
}

% ---- Blocks: solid accent titles on a light surface body ----
\setbeamertemplate{blocks}[default]
\setbeamercolor{block title}{fg=white,bg=accentblue}
\setbeamercolor{block body}{fg=pkmsink,bg=surface}
\setbeamercolor{block title alerted}{fg=white,bg=accentred}
\setbeamercolor{block body alerted}{fg=pkmsink,bg=surface}
\setbeamercolor{block title example}{fg=white,bg=accentgreen}
\setbeamercolor{block body example}{fg=pkmsink,bg=surface}

% ---- Itemize markers: small square in the accent color ----
\setbeamertemplate{itemize item}{\raise0.18ex\hbox{\color{accentblue}\rule{0.7ex}{0.7ex}}}
\setbeamertemplate{itemize subitem}{\color{accentgray}\textendash}
\setbeamertemplate{itemize subsubitem}{\color{accentgray}\textperiodcentered}
